## Summary

Full-inventory cohort review of all 3,012 AntibioticRecord YAML files in data/antibiotics/ at commit 2cc3ea13020683af56460711fbff425aa2dad456. Partitioned the frozen 3,012-record inventory by antimicrobial filing class (7 directories: antibacterial 1,108; antifungal 602; antiviral 473; unspecified 472; antiprotozoal 248; antimycobacterial 78; biocide 31) and by curation-readiness cohort (63 REVIEWED with primary-literature causal_graphs; 33 REVIEWED awaiting causal_graphs; 21 PROPOSED with curated PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets and mode_of_action; 10 PROPOSED with curated mode_of_action awaiting PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets; 66 PROPOSED awaiting primary mechanism curation; 2,819 SEEDED baseline records). Verified 0 closed-schema or OAK label errors across all 3,012 records, 0 duplicate chemical structures, and 100% UniProtKB protein_examples coverage across all 46 GENE_OR_PROTEIN causal-graph nodes (82 reviewed UniProtKB accessions; 21 non-protein causal graphs held) and all 59 protein-direct PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular targets (108 reviewed UniProtKB accessions; 64 non-protein/complex targets explicitly held in curation/uniprot_protein_examples.yaml). Identified 11 stable findings: 3 open findings across 12 records for Cycle 3 Stage 5 grouped remediation (2 PROPOSED/EXACT records ready for REVIEWED promotion; 3 PROPOSED/EXACT fluoroquinolones with curated mode_of_action needing PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets + REVIEWED promotion; and 7 PROPOSED/MINTED records with curated mode_of_action needing PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets) and 8 deferred findings carried forward from Cycle 2 Stage 5.

## Findings

### proposed-exact-records-with-primary-targets-awaiting-reviewed-promotion: Two PROPOSED EXACT ChEBI records have complete primary-literature mechanism and target curation but remain curation_status: PROPOSED

major / open / confirmed; issue key: proposed-exact-records-with-primary-targets-awaiting-reviewed-promotion.

Two EXACT ChEBI records seeded in Cycle 3 Stage 1 and curated in Cycle 3 Stage 2 — bactobolin A (CHEBI:138579, DOI:10.1073/pnas.1419328112 / PMID:25733897) and negamycin (CHEBI:198310, DOI:10.1073/pnas.1414401111 / PMID:25368144; DOI:10.1016/j.molcel.2014.09.021 / PMID:25306922) — possess exact single-molecule chemical_structure, curated biosynthesis_origin (NATURAL_PRODUCT), curated mode_of_action (PROTEIN_SYNTHESIS_INHIBITION) with mode_of_action_target_scope: MICROBIAL_TARGET and CURATOR mode_of_action_notes, source: PRIMARY_LITERATURE (evidence_status: PRIMARY_EVIDENCE) molecular_targets, and documented RIBOSOMAL_SUBUNIT holds in curation/uniprot_protein_examples.yaml, yet retain curation_status: PROPOSED.

### proposed-exact-quinolones-with-moa-missing-primary-targets-and-reviewed-promotion: Three PROPOSED EXACT fluoroquinolone records have curated mode_of_action and primary target citations but lack structured PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets and REVIEWED promotion

major / open / confirmed; issue key: proposed-exact-quinolones-with-moa-missing-primary-targets-and-reviewed-promotion.

Three PROPOSED antibacterial fluoroquinolone records with grounding_status: EXACT and complete single-molecule chemical_structure — besifloxacin (CHEBI:135622, Cambau et al. 2009 DOI:10.1093/jac/dkn528 / PMID:19451292; DOI:10.1128/AAC.00418-09 / PMID:19506065), ozenoxacin (CHEBI:136050, Yamakawa et al. 2002 DOI:10.1128/AAC.46.5.1229-1234.2002 / PMID:11959549; Lopez et al. 2014 PMID:24752267), and pazufloxacin (CHEBI:94700, DOI:10.1128/AAC.37.3.384 / PMID:8460909; PMID:11959571) — already carry curated biosynthesis_origin: SYNTHETIC, mode_of_action: DNA_REPLICATION_INHIBITION (MICROBIAL_TARGET), and CURATOR mode_of_action_notes describing dual inhibition of bacterial DNA gyrase (GyrA/GyrB) and topoisomerase IV (ParC/ParE), but lack structured source: PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets (and reviewed UniProtKB protein_examples) and remain curation_status: PROPOSED.

### proposed-minted-records-with-moa-missing-primary-targets: Seven PROPOSED MINTED records have curated mode_of_action and primary target citations but lack structured PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets

major / open / confirmed; issue key: proposed-minted-records-with-moa-missing-primary-targets.

Seven PROPOSED/MINTED records with exact single-molecule chemical_structure, curated biosynthesis_origin, curated mode_of_action (MICROBIAL_TARGET), and CURATOR mode_of_action_notes — cadazolid (antibioticmech:curator-975acd7c4d, Locher et al. 2014 DOI:10.1128/AAC.02158-13 / PMID:24366740), radezolid (antibioticmech:curator-a739fc0555, Lawrence et al. 2008 DOI:10.1128/AAC.01990-08 / PMID:19332677), sutezolid (antibioticmech:curator-f56d459cee, Williams et al. 2009 DOI:10.1128/AAC.00059-07 / PMID:18056279), sanfetrinem (antibioticmech:curator-daae3d88a3, Di Modugno et al. 1994 DOI:10.1128/AAC.38.10.2362 / PMID:7840571), tomopenem (antibioticmech:curator-e14f58e6dc, Koga et al. 2008 DOI:10.1128/AAC.00105-08 / PMID:18519725), albaconazole (antibioticmech:curator-6bdee75cea, Bartroli et al. 1998 DOI:10.1021/jm9707277 / PMID:9602591), and quilseconazole (antibioticmech:curator-217ed2935e, Warrilow et al. 2017 DOI:10.1128/AAC.02116-16 / PMID:27919896) — cite primary target studies in mode_of_action_notes/source_concepts but lack structured PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets (and UniProtKB protein_examples / held_targets accounting).

### mcr43-context: Contrasting functional contexts and component-specific grounding for MCR-4.3 remain unresolved

minor / deferred / confirmed; issue key: card-aro-3004695-mcr43-contrasting-functional-contexts.

CARD ARO:3004695 (MCR-4.3) on colistin A (CHEBI:59064) and colistin B (CHEBI:59673) carries source-owned qualifications via curation/card_evidence_reviews.json, but purified component-specific experimental testing and primary supplement reconciliation remain unresolved.

Disposition: Source-owned qualification notes are already projected via curation/card_evidence_reviews.json; component-specific experimental grounding requires external primary experimental data not available in local cached sources.

### eatav-compound: Tested pleuromutilin derivative (tiamulin) in eatAv study does not ground parent pleuromutilin

minor / deferred / confirmed; issue key: card-aro-3003761-eatav-pleuromutilin-derivative-mismatch.

CARD ARO:3003761 (eatAv) on pleuromutilin (CHEBI:8269) cites PMID:23751969, which tested tiamulin rather than parent pleuromutilin; source-owned qualification is projected via curation/card_evidence_reviews.json.

Disposition: Derivative-versus-parent qualification note is already projected via curation/card_evidence_reviews.json; exact parent pleuromutilin experimental testing is absent from the cited primary study.

### msrc-evidence: Early msrC association study does not establish exclusive causality or target-protection mechanism

minor / deferred / confirmed; issue key: card-aro-3002819-msrc-association-vs-causality.

CARD ARO:3002819 (msrC) on erythromycin A (CHEBI:42355) and quinupristin (CHEBI:8732) cites PMID:11120975, which reports susceptibility shifts without proving exclusive target-protection causality.

Disposition: Awaits later primary mechanistic evidence curation and native gene-field representation on source-owned ResistanceMechanismEntry items.

### ddl-scope: Generic D-Ala-D-Ala ligase reference on vancomycin leaves tested alteration unresolved

minor / deferred / confirmed; issue key: card-aro-3003970-vancomycin-ddl-paywall-hold.

CARD ARO:3003970 (D-Ala-D-Ala ligase) on vancomycin (CHEBI:28001) cites PMID:11266628 (abstract-only access; full text under publisher HTTP 403 hold) and review PMID:16323117.

Disposition: Full-text primary results for PMID:11266628 remain unavailable under publisher HTTP 403 access hold; experimental allele identity cannot be inferred from abstract or review text.

### mexjk-role-conflict: Upstream CARD aro.owl reverses MexJ and MexK component roles in MexJK-OpmH relative to MexJK-OprM

minor / deferred / confirmed; issue key: card-aro-3003694-mexjk-opmh-component-role-reversal.

Upstream aro.owl assigns opposite inner-membrane versus periplasmic-adaptor restrictions for MexJ (ARO:3003692) and MexK (ARO:3003693) in MexJK-OpmH (ARO:3003694) relative to MexJK-OprM (ARO:3000802), affecting complex provenance on erythromycin A (CHEBI:42355), tetracycline (CHEBI:27902), triclosan (CHEBI:164200), and acriflavine (antibioticmech:aro-1fe0873afd).

Disposition: Primary papers PMID:12193619 and PMID:12951344 remain under publisher HTTP 403 hold, and generated AntibioticRecord files do not store subcomponent role restrictions; preserved without guessing which upstream CARD restriction is correct.

### reviewed-records-awaiting-causal-graphs: 33 REVIEWED records await primary-literature causal_graphs and ofloxacin is blocked by structureless CHEBI:7731

informational / deferred / confirmed; issue key: reviewed-records-awaiting-causal-graphs.

After Cycle 3 Stage 2 curated primary-literature causal_graphs on 13 additional REVIEWED records, 63 of the 96 REVIEWED records now carry causal_graphs while 33 of the 96 REVIEWED records have verified primary-literature mode_of_action and molecular_targets but do not yet have curated causal_graphs; additionally, ofloxacin (antibioticmech:aro-2eea3233f3) has a primary-literature causal graph (PMID:2849927, with reviewed UniProtKB protein_examples P0AES4/P0AES6 on dna_gyrase) and CARD_ARO molecular_targets but remains SEEDED/MINTED because racemic CHEBI:7731 lacks a 2D molfile in ChEBI v249.

Disposition: Curating new multi-step primary-literature causal_graphs across 33 additional REVIEWED compounds and resolving upstream ChEBI structure availability for racemic CHEBI:7731 are multi-cycle corpus expansion tasks tracked in Issue #1257 outside bounded Stage 5 coherence remediation.

### proposed-antibacterial-records-awaiting-grounding-and-mechanism: 66 PROPOSED literature-seeded records await primary mechanism curation and structure registration

informational / deferred / confirmed; issue key: proposed-antibacterial-records-awaiting-grounding-and-mechanism.

66 of the 97 PROPOSED records across data/antibiotics/ (22 EXACT ChEBI, 44 MINTED without exact ChEBI structure) have CURATOR discovery literature citations and verified single-molecule structures (on 64/66), but do not yet have curated mode_of_action, PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets, or causal_graphs.

Disposition: Requires compound-by-compound primary mechanism literature retrieval and upstream ChEBI structure registration across future dedicated curation cycles (tracked in Issue #1258).

### minted-aro-records-without-exact-chebi-structure: 240 SEEDED MINTED records lack an exact single-molecule ChEBI chemical_structure

informational / deferred / confirmed; issue key: minted-aro-records-without-exact-chebi-structure.

240 SEEDED records carry minted antibioticmech:aro-* identifiers and grounding_status: MINTED because upstream CARD ARO terms or ChEBI v249 entries represent antibiotic classes, multi-component mixtures, polymers, or structureless entries.

Disposition: REVIEWED promotion is intentionally gated by structure_completeness_audit until exact single-molecule ChEBI structures or complex-mixture policy support is available (tracked in Issue #1259).

## Evidence

| Evidence | Reference / locator | Support | Observation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| strict-validation-suite | scripts/validate_strict.py; Full-corpus closed-schema and OAK label validation | supports | Validated 3,012 YAML files in data/antibiotics/ against src/antibioticmech/schema/antibioticmech.yaml and local sqlite OAK adapters with 0 errors. |
| corpus-verification-suite | scripts/verify_corpus.py; Full-corpus seeder and citation integrity check | supports | Verified 3,012 records (2,819 SEEDED, 96 REVIEWED, 97 PROPOSED; 2,702 EXACT, 310 MINTED) with 0 errors. |
| structure-audit | docs/HARMONIZATION.md; Structure completeness and REVIEWED gate specification | supports | Confirmed 96/96 REVIEWED records have grounding_status: EXACT and full chemical_structure; 2/97 PROPOSED records (bactobolin A CHEBI:138579, negamycin CHEBI:198310) have EXACT ChEBI grounding with complete primary mechanism and target curation and are immediately eligible for REVIEWED promotion, and 3/97 PROPOSED records (besifloxacin CHEBI:135622, ozenoxacin CHEBI:136050, pazufloxacin CHEBI:94700) have EXACT ChEBI grounding and curated mode_of_action needing PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets + REVIEWED promotion. |
| proposed-primary-target-cohort-evidence | curation/uniprot_protein_examples.yaml; UniProtKB protein_examples and held_targets accounting across 117 records with PRIMARY_LITERATURE targets | supports | 21 PROPOSED records have curated mode_of_action and PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets (2 EXACT: bactobolin A CHEBI:138579 and negamycin CHEBI:198310; 19 MINTED), while 10 PROPOSED records (3 EXACT fluoroquinolones: besifloxacin CHEBI:135622, ozenoxacin CHEBI:136050, pazufloxacin CHEBI:94700; and 7 MINTED records: cadazolid, radezolid, sutezolid, sanfetrinem, tomopenem, albaconazole, quilseconazole) have curated mode_of_action and primary target citations in notes/provenance but lack structured PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets. |
| card-evidence-reviews-plan | curation/card_evidence_reviews.json; Source-owned CARD qualification notes for Issues #1140-#1144 | supports | Documents upstream CARD literature-alignment qualifications and publisher access holds for MCR-4.3 (CHEBI:59064, CHEBI:59673; Issue #1140), eatAv (CHEBI:8269; Issue #1141), MexJK-OpmH (CHEBI:42355, CHEBI:27902, CHEBI:164200, antibioticmech:aro-1fe0873afd; Issue #1142), msrC (CHEBI:42355, CHEBI:8732; Issue #1143), and vancomycin ddl (CHEBI:28001; Issue #1144). |
| causal-graphs-plan | curation/causal_graphs.yaml; 64 records with 65 curated primary-literature causal_graphs | supports | 63 REVIEWED records plus SEEDED/MINTED ofloxacin (antibioticmech:aro-2eea3233f3) now carry 65 primary-literature causal_graphs (up from 51 records / 52 graphs before Cycle 3 Stage 2), leaving 33 of the 96 REVIEWED records awaiting causal_graphs. |

## Limits And Additional Notes

- Stage 4 is a read-only review stage; no scientific YAML records were modified in this commit sequence.
- External publisher HTTP 403 paywalls continue to block full-text verification of PMID:11266628 (vancomycin ddl) and PMID:12193619/PMID:12951344 (MexJK-OpmH).
- All 3 open findings (12 records total: 2 PROPOSED/EXACT records ready for REVIEWED promotion, 3 PROPOSED/EXACT fluoroquinolones needing PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets + REVIEWED promotion, and 7 PROPOSED/MINTED records with curated mode_of_action needing PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets) are preserved with exact target IDs, field paths, and acceptance checks for Cycle 3 Stage 5 grouped remediation.

- assessment_id: proposed-curated-moa-and-target-coherence
  area: completeness
  topic: Coherence and status alignment across the 31 PROPOSED records with curated
    mode_of_action and/or PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets
  outcome: concern
  summary: 'Of the 31 PROPOSED records with curated mode_of_action, 21 already carry
    PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets (including 2 EXACT ChEBI records — bactobolin
    A CHEBI:138579 and negamycin CHEBI:198310 — that meet every requirement for REVIEWED
    promotion), while 10 carry curated mode_of_action and primary target citations
    in mode_of_action_notes/provenance but lack structured PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets
    (3 EXACT fluoroquinolones: besifloxacin CHEBI:135622, ozenoxacin CHEBI:136050,
    pazufloxacin CHEBI:94700; and 7 MINTED records: cadazolid, radezolid, sutezolid,
    sanfetrinem, tomopenem, albaconazole, quilseconazole).'

- finding_id: proposed-exact-records-with-primary-targets-awaiting-reviewed-promotion
  issue_key: proposed-exact-records-with-primary-targets-awaiting-reviewed-promotion
  category: completeness
  severity: major
  status: open
  certainty: confirmed
  title: 'Two PROPOSED EXACT ChEBI records have complete primary-literature mechanism
    and target curation but remain curation_status: PROPOSED'
  description: 'Two EXACT ChEBI records seeded in Cycle 3 Stage 1 and curated in Cycle
    3 Stage 2 — bactobolin A (CHEBI:138579, DOI:10.1073/pnas.1419328112 / PMID:25733897)
    and negamycin (CHEBI:198310, DOI:10.1073/pnas.1414401111 / PMID:25368144; DOI:10.1016/j.molcel.2014.09.021
    / PMID:25306922) — possess exact single-molecule chemical_structure, curated biosynthesis_origin
    (NATURAL_PRODUCT), curated mode_of_action (PROTEIN_SYNTHESIS_INHIBITION) with
    mode_of_action_target_scope: MICROBIAL_TARGET and CURATOR mode_of_action_notes,
    source: PRIMARY_LITERATURE (evidence_status: PRIMARY_EVIDENCE) molecular_targets,
    and documented RIBOSOMAL_SUBUNIT holds in curation/uniprot_protein_examples.yaml,
    yet retain curation_status: PROPOSED.'
  target_ids:
  - CHEBI:138579
  - CHEBI:198310
  field_paths:
  - curation_status
  - curation_history
  evidence_ids:

- finding_id: proposed-exact-quinolones-with-moa-missing-primary-targets-and-reviewed-promotion
  issue_key: proposed-exact-quinolones-with-moa-missing-primary-targets-and-reviewed-promotion
  category: completeness
  severity: major
  status: open
  certainty: confirmed
  title: Three PROPOSED EXACT fluoroquinolone records have curated mode_of_action
    and primary target citations but lack structured PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets
    and REVIEWED promotion
  description: 'Three PROPOSED antibacterial fluoroquinolone records with grounding_status:
    EXACT and complete single-molecule chemical_structure — besifloxacin (CHEBI:135622,
    Cambau et al. 2009 DOI:10.1093/jac/dkn528 / PMID:19451292; DOI:10.1128/AAC.00418-09
    / PMID:19506065), ozenoxacin (CHEBI:136050, Yamakawa et al. 2002 DOI:10.1128/AAC.46.5.1229-1234.2002
    / PMID:11959549; Lopez et al. 2014 PMID:24752267), and pazufloxacin (CHEBI:94700,
    DOI:10.1128/AAC.37.3.384 / PMID:8460909; PMID:11959571) — already carry curated
    biosynthesis_origin: SYNTHETIC, mode_of_action: DNA_REPLICATION_INHIBITION (MICROBIAL_TARGET),
    and CURATOR mode_of_action_notes describing dual inhibition of bacterial DNA gyrase
    (GyrA/GyrB) and topoisomerase IV (ParC/ParE), but lack structured source: PRIMARY_LITERATURE
    molecular_targets (and reviewed UniProtKB protein_examples) and remain curation_status:
    PROPOSED.'
  target_ids:
  - CHEBI:135622
  - CHEBI:136050
  - CHEBI:94700

  description: Seven PROPOSED/MINTED records with exact single-molecule chemical_structure,

    Lawrence et al. 2008 DOI:10.1128/AAC.01990-08 / PMID:19332677), sutezolid (antibioticmech:curator-f56d459cee,

    Di Modugno et al. 1994 DOI:10.1128/AAC.38.10.2362 / PMID:7840571), tomopenem (antibioticmech:curator-e14f58e6dc,
    Koga et al. 2008 DOI:10.1128/AAC.00105-08 / PMID:18519725), albaconazole (antibioticmech:curator-6bdee75cea,
    Bartroli et al. 1998 DOI:10.1021/jm9707277 / PMID:9602591), and quilseconazole
    (antibioticmech:curator-217ed2935e, Warrilow et al. 2017 DOI:10.1128/AAC.02116-16
    / PMID:27919896) — cite primary target studies in mode_of_action_notes/source_concepts

    / held_targets accounting).

- finding_id: mexjk-role-conflict
  issue_key: card-aro-3003694-mexjk-opmh-component-role-reversal
  category: consistency
  severity: minor
  status: deferred
  certainty: confirmed
  title: Upstream CARD aro.owl reverses MexJ and MexK component roles in MexJK-OpmH
    relative to MexJK-OprM
  description: Upstream aro.owl assigns opposite inner-membrane versus periplasmic-adaptor
    restrictions for MexJ (ARO:3003692) and MexK (ARO:3003693) in MexJK-OpmH (ARO:3003694)
    relative to MexJK-OprM (ARO:3000802), affecting complex provenance on erythromycin
    A (CHEBI:42355), tetracycline (CHEBI:27902), triclosan (CHEBI:164200), and acriflavine
    (antibioticmech:aro-1fe0873afd).
  disposition_reason: Primary papers PMID:12193619 and PMID:12951344 remain under
    publisher HTTP 403 hold, and generated AntibioticRecord files do not store subcomponent
    role restrictions; preserved without guessing which upstream CARD restriction
    is correct.
  target_ids:

  - CHEBI:27902

actions:
- action_id: promote-proposed-exact-records-with-primary-targets-to-reviewed
  description: 'Promote the 2 PROPOSED EXACT ChEBI records that already have complete
    single-molecule chemical_structure, biosynthesis_origin, mode_of_action, mode_of_action_target_scope:
    MICROBIAL_TARGET, CURATOR mode_of_action_notes, and source: PRIMARY_LITERATURE
    molecular_targets (bactobolin A CHEBI:138579, negamycin CHEBI:198310) from curation_status:
    PROPOSED to REVIEWED via record_curation_event and write_validated_antibiotic
    during Cycle 3 Stage 5 grouped remediation.'
  finding_ids:
  - proposed-exact-records-with-primary-targets-awaiting-reviewed-promotion
  target_ids:
  - CHEBI:138579
  - CHEBI:198310
  owner_paths:
  - repository: culturebotai/AntibioticMech
    path: data/antibiotics/antibacterial/bactobolin-a.yaml
    role: Curator-owned curation_status slot on EXACT record
  - repository: culturebotai/AntibioticMech
    path: data/antibiotics/antibacterial/negamycin.yaml
    role: Curator-owned curation_status slot on EXACT record
  acceptance_checks:
  - 'Both CHEBI:138579 and CHEBI:198310 carry curation_status: REVIEWED and survive
    seed_from_sources.py --apply.'
  - scripts/validate_strict.py and scripts/verify_corpus.py pass with 0 errors.
- action_id: curate-primary-targets-and-promote-proposed-exact-quinolones
  description: 'Populate structured source: PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular_targets (bacterial
    DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV with reviewed Swiss-Prot UniProtKB protein_examples)
    and promote CHEBI:135622 (besifloxacin), CHEBI:136050 (ozenoxacin), and CHEBI:94700
    (pazufloxacin) from curation_status: PROPOSED to REVIEWED via record_curation_event
    and write_validated_antibiotic during Cycle 3 Stage 5 grouped remediation.'
  finding_ids:
  - proposed-exact-quinolones-with-moa-missing-primary-targets-and-reviewed-promotion
  target_ids:
  - CHEBI:135622
  - CHEBI:136050
  - CHEBI:94700

    role: Curator-owned molecular_targets and curation_status slots on EXACT record
  - repository: culturebotai/AntibioticMech

    with reviewed UniProtKB protein_examples and curation_status: REVIEWED.'
  - scripts/validate_strict.py and scripts/verify_corpus.py pass with 0 errors.
